Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns for the calcined AuCu/FeOx dumbbell NCs showed the presence of Au and maghemite upon calcination, and for the D3-A sample, a contribution was also observed from a hematite phase, as the HRTEM results suggested (Fig. 4). The HAADF-STEM images of the activated catalysts showed the formation of dumbbell NCs with a hollow MOx domain, particularly for the D2-A and D3-A samples (Fig. 1).
